item.title: Breeze Airlines Offering New Direct Flights to Ft. Lauderdale from Salisbury
item.description: SALISBURY, Md. – Breeze Airways has announced that they will be offering a nonstop route to Fort Lauderdale, Florida, from Salisbury-Ocean City with service on Wednesdays and Saturdays, starting Jul. 1.
